meta.title: Starflux — Light curve photometry, on your desktop
meta.description: Starflux is an open-source native desktop app for differential aperture photometry on FITS image series — exoplanet transits, variable stars, asteroid occultations. Free for macOS, Windows, and Linux.

hero.eyebrow: Open source · Go · Alpha targeted December 2026
hero.sub: Starflux is a native desktop app for differential aperture photometry on FITS image series — exoplanet transits, variable stars, asteroid occultations, and other light-curve science. Spiritual successor to FotoDif.

features.title: Built for the observing session
features.sub: A complete workflow from raw FITS frames to a publishable light curve.

items.title: FITS image series
items.body: Load a single file, multiple files, or an entire folder of an observing run.

items.title: Aperture photometry
items.body: Sub-pixel centroiding, aperture sum, and sigma-clipped sky annulus background subtraction.

items.title: Differential light curves
items.body: Target, comparison, and check stars — named and unlimited, not fixed to three.

items.title: Resumable sessions
items.body: Save and restore star positions and processed results — pick up an interrupted run exactly where it left off.

items.title: Observer mode
items.body: A red-light theme that preserves night vision at the telescope, toggled live with no restart.

items.title: AAVSO export
items.body: Export results in the AAVSO Extended File Format, ready to submit.

pipeline.title: The measurement pipeline
pipeline.sub: Three steps per selected star, from raw counts to a differential magnitude.

steps.title: Centroid
steps.body: Refine an approximate pixel position to a sub-pixel center of mass, weighted by ADU intensity.

steps.title: Aperture sum
steps.body: Sum ADUs within radius r_ap of the centroid, with sub-pixel edge weighting.

steps.title: Sky subtraction
steps.body: Subtract the sigma-clipped sky annulus background to get net flux.

download.title: Download Starflux
download.sub: Grab the {latest_release} once the alpha ships. Binaries are not code-signed yet: macOS Gatekeeper and Windows SmartScreen will warn on first launch.
download.note: macOS: right-click the app inside the mounted .dmg and choose "Open" instead of double-clicking (or run {cmd} from Terminal). Windows: click "More info" → "Run anyway" on the SmartScreen prompt.

roadmap.title: Roadmap
roadmap.sub: Alpha targeted for December 2026, Beta in 2027. No v1.0.0 date is set yet.

items.body: Core measurement pipeline: load FITS → mark stars → aperture photometry → differential light curve → save/export.
Named/multiple stars, resumable sessions, error tolerance control, header metadata in the star picker.
Configuration UI, star-tracking drift plot, tilt correction, AAVSO export, automatic star detection.
Watch-folder processing, field-wide variable search, Lomb-Scargle period analysis.
Cross-validation of photometry results against FotoDif, then the first tagged alpha release.

roadmap.footer: See the {changelog} for what shipped in each version, and the {readme} in the README.
